messages:
Harper: thinking aloud — proposal for a "preview" sandbox token for Console preview sessions. short-lived, scoped to a project+role. should route to the same model pool/region so latency/quotas match the dev project. want routing + quota attribution feedback.
Samir: +1. two quick Qs: how do we tag these for billing/telemetry, and what happens if preview token hits capacity? @Maya fyi for SRE constraints.
Olivia: product perspective — previews used by PMs & sales demos. needs simple flow: 'Create preview' -> token modal -> shareable link. must surface quota consumption in the preview UI and clearly label as sandbox :warning:.
Maya: SRE concerns: (1) never route previews to prod-only clusters; (2) prevent quota leakage. suggestions: default TTL 10-20m, enforced rate cap, explicit project_id attr in telemetry.
Samir: routing idea: preview token contains claims like preview_project=<proj_id> & preview_affinity=true. Router policy: prefer project pool, then dedicated fallback; if no capacity, fallback to a shared preview pool with throttling + a visible banner.
Harper: sketch of token claims (pseudo):

```
alg: HS256
claims: {
  \"sub\": \"preview:harper:ui-123\",
  \"proj\": \"proj_foo\",
  \"role\": \"viewer\",
  \"exp\": 1718005321,
  \"preview\": true,
  \"affinity\": \"preferred\"
}
```

header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or accept `X-Preview-Token: <token>` for links.
Olivia: UI question — shall creators extend TTL? sales wants 1h/8h demo options. probably gated by org plan and admin approval.
Maya: require org-admin permission `preview-extend` to allow longer TTLs. audit logs must record create/extend actions. automatic revocation on abuse patterns (spikes, odd endpoints).
Samir: telemetry tags to emit from router: preview=true, creator_id, project_id, route_pool, fallback_reason, quota_bucket. these feed usage dashboards and allow billing to filter preview usage out.
Harper: rollout plan: 1) internal alpha (eng + product), tokens via console flag; 2) opt-in beta for selected customers; 3) GA with admin controls + telemetry alerts. migration plan needed for existing demo links.
Olivia: add a small CTA in preview UI: 'Report issue with preview' so sales/PMs can flag routing or quality problems quickly.
Maya: security checklist: ephemeral signing key rotation, token revocation endpoint, guard to prevent preview tokens from accessing admin-only endpoints (billing/org management).
Samir: impl notes: router must parse token claims before full authz to route correctly. add fast-path cache for preview token->route mapping with TTL shorter than token TTL.
Harper: router fallback pseudocode:

```
if token.preview:
  try project_pool
  except CapacityError:
    if org_allows_preview_fallback:
      route shared_preview_pool
      mark fallback_reason
    else:
      return 429 with \"preview capacity exhausted\"
```

Maya: prefer explicit 429 + a UI banner over silent fallback — sales hates silent degradation.
Olivia: +1. if routed to shared pool show latency and cost impact in the UI.
Samir: next steps: I'll draft the API spec for preview token issuance + metadata headers. @Harper can you mock console UX flows? I'll include telemetry fields.
Harper: will do a quick Figma mock and share the link.
DeployBot: Note: feature-flag `console_previews` created in staging. Use `/ff console_previews on` to enable for your org in staging. :robot_face:
Maya: adding SRE staging alerts for preview pool saturation.
Harper: thanks all — I'll draft a doc with API sketches, rollout timeline, and a migration plan. :raised_hands:
